adoption_reason: Conditional observational evidence for one anonymous Devin account using only Claude Opus 5.5. The plan tier is not verified in the logs. The sample meets medium under delta_sample_stability_v1 but is thin (18pp, 34 calls, 1.67 effective segments) and must not be averaged with other accounts or with prior rounds. The estimate does not replace adopted rows. CONVENTIONS.md section 3 requires maintainer resolution before any adoption.

lowCacheTokenMix.labelEn: Low-cache workload: 85% cache reads / 14.5% fresh input / 0.5% output
lowCacheTokenMix.note: 2026-09-22 裁定的第二档统一负载，用于实测打不到标准 97% cache 的渠道（当前：Step 全系、Google——Gemini 实测 82.6% 属同族，2026-09-30 裁定其实测样本按标价折 worth 后用本档换算）。锚点：step-5-preview 本机实测 mix 79.0%/20.7%/0.34%（210.17M tokens，stepfun-step5-panel-round5-2026-09-21.json）与 Google AI Pro 实测 82.6%，统一取 85% 档；step5 采用值的 decision_note 内保留 79% 实测口径对照数。非cache部分输出占比 0.5% 跟随标准负载、余量归输入。2026-09-23 随标准档由 85%/14.65%/0.35% 修订（standard-token-mix-round2-2026-09-23.json）。

anthropicTokenMix.labelZh: Anthropic 统一负载：缓存读97% / 缓存写2.5% / 输出0.5%
anthropicTokenMix.labelEn: Anthropic workload: 97% cache reads / 2.5% cache writes / 0.5% output
anthropicTokenMix.note: Anthropic 单独收缓存写入费，未命中缓存的输入几乎全部走缓存写（Devin 面板 input 0.001%/write 7.67%；MiaAI Claude Code 样本 input 0.14%/write 2.05%），故标准档的普通输入份额对 Anthropic 按 5 分钟缓存写入价计；份额与 standardTokenMix 联动（cacheWrite = standard.input）。2026-09-24 裁定。

qualification_policy.interpretation: Local evidence rubric; thresholds are not vendor rules or confidence probabilities

methodology.equation: weekly_official_api_equivalent_usd = 100 * sum(sample official API value USD) / sum(delta percentage points)
methodology.unit: USD per week for one anonymous account using only Claude Opus 5.5 until 100% of the weekly quota, at the observed cache mix
methodology.effective_segments: (sum(delta_pp))^2 / sum(delta_pp^2), after merging contiguous pure-model runs
methodology.leave_one_out: Maximum relative change in the pooled estimate after dropping one whole contiguous run. Undefined for a single run, which fails medium.
methodology.rounding: Conservative 1pp uncertainty per merged run, divided by total delta. The published range is a sensitivity envelope from request-timestamp shifts of +/-120s and +/-300s and each run delta +/-1pp. It is not a statistical confidence interval.
methodology.token_semantics: Official Anthropic input_tokens exclude cache reads and cache creation. cache_write_5m and cache_write_1h are parts of cache creation, not charges on top of the creation total. Output includes thinking; do not add reasoning again. Collector-adapter equivalence is assumed, and the alternate maximum-overlap input treatment is inside the sensitivity envelope.
not_used: No subscription price was used to fit or check the estimate.
Daily and weekly pools are not added.
methodology.scope: One anonymous subscription account × one model × 100% of the weekly quota, official API equivalent at the observed workload only.

official_facts.context: Full 1M context at standard prices. No batch, fast-mode, region, tool or tax premium is assumed. Rates are unchanged from the 2026-11-16 round3 check.

confidence_assessment.rounding_basis: Conservative sum of 1pp remaining-difference uncertainty per contiguous run / total delta; aggregate-only 1pp ratio also reported.

plan_identity.note: No invoice or tier evidence; no plan value used to validate estimate. Logs do not record a Devin plan label this week.

limitations: Only local Magpie aligned request logs and quota history were available. Endpoint authenticity, omitted stream activity and activity outside the selected intervals are not independently authenticated.
Conditional on recorded requests explaining quota drops in the selected pure-model intervals; no completed collector-adapter semantic audit.
Observed cache-heavy workload only; not a workload-independent entitlement or guarantee of future throughput.

The qualifying sample is thin: 18 percentage points, 34 token-bearing calls, two runs, 1.67 effective segments. It meets medium and misses high. The sensitivity envelope is wide because the second run is only 5pp.

The weekly cycle was observed from 100 to 0, but the last cycle reading is 2026-11-18T01:50:47Z, leaving 102.2h unobserved before reset. Remaining was already 0 at that last reading. Four collector gaps over 6h in the cycle truncated candidate bins conservatively.
Two zero-token swe-2 rows with HTTP 499 occurred inside the first run and were excluded from value and from the token-bearing purity test.
A mixed swe-2 / Opus / Sonnet interval of about 21pp sits between the two published runs and was excluded. The two runs are not a mechanical split of one contiguous interval.
No daily/weekly summing, cross-account pooling, known-plan calibration or automatic adopted-value change.
Devin plan tier is unknown and is not inferred from the size of the estimate or from round2/round3 figures for this or other accounts.

verification_summary.independent_recalculation: The 34 public CSV rows were rebuilt from the request log and independently valued at official Opus 5.5 standard rates. Sample total 5.3335702 USD matches 100 * total / 18 = 29.630945555555556 USD/week. Cache-creation total equals the 5-minute plus 1-hour subcounts on every included row. Qualification metrics were recounted: neff=1.670103, CV=0.049110, LOO=0.079187, rounding=0.111111, all medium gates pass, high gates fail as listed.
verification_summary.medium_rule: Whole contiguous pure-model runs, not sub-bins. A06 meets medium and misses high (delta, calls, effective segments, and rounding).
verification_summary.limits: Interval identity and purity outside the published windows, and activity not present in the local logs, are not independently authenticated. No invoice or collector-adapter audit is in this public file. The envelope describes the observed cache-heavy workload only. Low-confidence diagnostics (A05, A09, A08, Codex) are exclusions only.
